# Desktop replay fixtures

Captured on 2026-10-29 with tools/spicerec, eight seconds per linked session.
Both first replays had zero Canvas.Errors. Initial golden.actual.png images
were visually inspected and copied to golden.png as instructed in task 3.
The human reviewed and approved all four golden.png images on 2026-10-29 as
correctly rendered desktops. This does not authorize automatic future golden updates.

| Fixture | Guest | Size | Canvas.Stats |
|---|---|---|---|
| win7-desktop | Windows 7 (confirmed by human context and desktop) | 800x600 | surface_create=1, copy=1, image_LzRgb=1 |
| win81-desktop | Windows 8.1 (matching desktop appearance) | 1024x768 | surface_create=1, copy=1, image_LzRgb=1 |

The desktops show a plain wallpaper and normal Windows taskbars, not black or
corrupt output. The Windows 7 capture includes a device installation notification.
Each directory contains four channels (main, display, inputs, cursor) plus
allowlisted metadata and a golden PNG. No API token or .vv file is included.

The original idle fixtures cover LZ_RGB only. Scripted fixtures below add GLZ
and QUIC. Neither VM is a Linux guest, so milestone 2's Windows/Linux guest
matrix remains incomplete even though all three codec types are now covered.

## Scripted fixtures (task 4)

Captured with `scripts/windows-rich.txt`, about 16 seconds each including script
execution and a two-second tail. New goldens were generated by first replay,
visually inspected, then copied as instructed; the human approved them on 2026-10-29.
Both final images show normal taskbars and desktop wallpaper with the opened
windows closed. Each fixture directory, including both PNGs, is under 5 MB.

| Fixture | Size | LZ_RGB | GLZ_RGB | QUIC | copy | copy_bits | Errors |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| win7-rich | 800x600 | 1 | 1895 | 29 | 1925 | 0 | 0 |
| win81-rich | 1024x768 | 1 | 861 | 1 | 863 | 0 | 0 |

Both also have surface_create=1. Counts match the live metadata and replay.
`copy` counts DrawCopy image updates and is distinct from `copy_bits`.
Opening Start, Paint, and the Windows wallpaper JPEG exercised all codecs.
The scripted keyboard window move did not produce CopyBits; these guest display
setups returned image updates instead. No QXL driver or server setting was changed.
Rich replay tests explicitly require each of the three codec counters to be
positive, in addition to zero errors and pixel-for-pixel golden equality.

## Linux guest fixture (2026-10-30)

Captured from the `ubuntu` guest (Ubuntu 26.04.1 Desktop, GNOME, logged in) with
`scripts/ubuntu-rich.txt`: Activities overview, Files opened from its search and
closed, the app grid, back to the desktop; 16 seconds including a two-second tail.
Scrubbed with `scrub.py` (VM name and UUID); no IPv4 address, VM ID, VM name or
account name appears in the channel bytes. The final frame shows the GNOME dock,
wallpaper and the desktop's Home icon, no account name. 1.1 MB in all.

| Fixture | Size | LZ_RGB | GLZ_RGB | QUIC | copy | copy_bits | Errors |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| ubuntu-rich | 640x512 | 1 | 47 | 0 | 48 | 0 | 0 |

Also surface_create=1. The guest ran at 640x480 at the time; the qxl primary
surface is 640x512 and SPICE_MSG_DISPLAY_MONITORS_CONFIG names the 640x480
monitor, which the canvas doesn't apply, so the bottom 32 rows stay black (finding
L2 of docs/verification/2026-10-30-ubuntu.md). Every draw is a full-frame
DrawCopy: the first LZ, every later one GLZ. The guest sent no QUIC, CopyBits or
video stream, so QUIC remains covered by the Windows fixtures only and milestone 2's
"a Linux guest recording covering QUIC" isn't met by this capture.

**Golden pending:** `ubuntu-rich` has no golden.png yet; the candidate awaits the
human's approval. Until then `ReplayMatchesRecordedStats` checks it (zero errors,
surface size and every canvas counter equal to the live `session.json`, LZ and GLZ
present); `DesktopMatchesGolden` lists it once the golden is approved. The same
stats test runs over the four Windows fixtures.
